name: Ride
notes:
REBUILT 2026-09-28 as a MODAL PLATE (gen1_cym_modes > 0 — see
gen_cymbal_modal in modular_stages.c) against the user-supplied jazz-ride
reference (ride-local). The legacy variant-4 voice — 10 fixed partials, a
white-noise burst and a 3 kHz sine bell — could not lose its "clappy, noisy"
strike by config: the noise burst alone put -7..-12 dB of flat energy above
11 kHz into the first 100 ms, where the reference has none. The reference
is a clean ring: partials clustered at 1.2-1.6 kHz and 2.3-3.4 kHz, sparse
sparkle at 8-15 kHz, doublets 4-12 Hz apart that beat (the "fuzz"), and a
decay that slows toward the bass (~17 dB/s at 1 kHz, ~45 dB/s at 11 kHz).

The values below were FITTED: a band x time energy map of the reference
(1/3-octave, 0.4-16 kHz, six windows 0-1.6 s) against the rendered voice,
minimized by coordinate descent — mean |error| 2.95 dB, against 12.8 dB for
the best legacy-voice candidate. Units: env_tail / env_fast are Np/s, the
*_f knobs Hz, the *_w knobs octaves.

Chosen BY EAR (2026-09-28) from five fitted takes: this one ("a bit more
metallic") over a faster-shimmer variant (cym_beat 0.0075, which matches the
reference's 8-20 Hz beating on the modulation spectrum) and a less-bright
one (HF residuals weighted 2x). The energy map cannot see beat rate, so the
modulation measurement lost to the ear here — keep that in mind before
"correcting" cym_beat toward the reference.

cym_variant stays 4: the modal plate runs only on the ride/crash variants, so
picking another Variant in the Synth tab still switches voice.

finish.notes: out_clamp: no output limit (these voices never had one)
